# SidePane

Header: `winui/ui/panes/SidePane.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/panes/SidePane.hpp`.

A content area with a pane beside it that opens, closes and collapses to a compact strip.

The view owns both the pane and the content. In the overlay modes an open pane closes on a click on the content or on Escape. That raises [on_pane_closing()](#on_pane_closing), which may cancel, and then closes the pane. Opening an overlay pane moves keyboard focus into it and keeps [Tab](../controls/tabs.md#uitab) there. The pane slides open and shut while the window animates, and changes at once otherwise. The declarative form is [ui::SidePane](#uisidepane).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<bool> open{false};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{ .content = {
    ui::Button{ .text = "Toggle pane", .on_click = [&] { open.toggle(); } },
    ui::SidePane{
        .is_pane_open   = open,
        .display_mode   = ui::SidePaneDisplayMode::CompactOverlay,
        .height         = 300,
        .on_pane_closed = [&] { open = false; }, // a light dismiss closes it without the binding
        .pane           = ui::Text{ .text = "PANE CONTENT", .margin = ui::Edges{.left = 60, .top = 12} },
        .content        = ui::Text{ .text = "Main content", .margin = ui::Thickness{12} },
    },
}});

// Imperatively:
auto split = std::make_unique<ui::SidePaneControl>();
split->set_display_mode(ui::SidePaneDisplayMode::Inline);
split->set_pane(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Pane"));
split->set_content(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Content"));
split->set_pane_open(true);
```

## `ui::SidePane`

A content area and a pane that opens beside or over it. Builds a [ui::SidePaneControl](#uisidepanecontrol). [`.open_pane_length`](#uisidepane-open_pane_length) unset is Auto, the pane's own width. [`.is_pane_open = prop`](#uisidepane-is_pane_open) is two-way. A light dismiss closes the pane and writes false into the property before [`.on_pane_closed`](#uisidepane-on_pane_closed) runs.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<bool> open{false};

window.set_content(ui::SidePane{
    .is_pane_open   = open,
    .display_mode   = ui::SidePaneDisplayMode::CompactOverlay,
    .height         = 400.0f,
    .pane           = ui::VerticalStack{.content = {ui::Text{.text = "Navigation"}}},
    .content        = ui::VerticalStack{.content = {
        ui::Button{.text = "Toggle pane", .on_click = [&] { open.toggle(); }},
    }},
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::SidePane{
    .is_pane_open, .display_mode, .pane_placement, .open_pane_length, .compact_pane_length,
    .light_dismiss_overlay_mode, .pane_background, .style, .margin, .width, .height,
    .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .accessibility, .on_pane_opening,
    .on_pane_opened, .on_pane_closing, .on_pane_closed, .on_pointer_entered,
    .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control,
    .pane, .content
}
```

### on_pane_closing

```cpp

```

The pane is about to close. Return [ui::Cancel](../core/namespace-ui.md#cancel) to keep it open. Only a light dismiss can be canceled. Closing through set_pane_open(false) raises it but closes regardless.

## Enumerations

### SidePaneDisplayMode

```cpp
enum class SidePaneDisplayMode
```

How a [SidePane](#uisidepane)'s pane is shown.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Overlay` | Closed: hidden. Open: the pane lies over the content. |
| `Inline` | Closed: hidden. Open: the content shrinks to make room beside the pane. |
| `CompactOverlay` | Closed: a compact strip. Open: the whole pane lies over the content. |
| `CompactInline` | Closed: a compact strip. Open: the whole pane sits beside the content. |

### SidePanePlacement

```cpp
enum class SidePanePlacement
```

Which side a [SidePane](#uisidepane)'s pane is on.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Left` | The pane on the left, the content to its right. |
| `Right` | The pane on the right. |

### LightDismissOverlayMode

```cpp
enum class LightDismissOverlayMode
```

Whether a light-dismissable surface dims what is behind it.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Auto` | Behaves as Off. |
| `On` | Dim what is behind the open surface. |
| `Off` | Never dim. |
